newsAll.head: Alec Pierce: Avoids heel surgery, in rehab mode
newsAll.body: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reiterated Monday that Pierce didn't undergo surgery on his left heel and is continuing to rehab the injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

newsAll.head: Nico Collins: Coach 'hopeful' for Week 4 return
newsAll.body: Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he's "hopeful" to have Collins available for the Texans' Week 4 game against the Cowboys, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

newsAll.head: Bucky Irving: Feeling fine after late exit Sunday
newsAll.body: Head coach Todd Bowles said that Irving won't be included on the Buccaneers' Week 4 injury report, despite missing the final two possessions of Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings, Scott Smith of the team's official site

newsAll.head: A.J. Brown: Seemingly making progress with ankle
newsAll.body: Brown was spotted Monday in the Patriots' locker room walking without a limp and wearing a small wrap on his injured right ankle, Taylor Kyles of CLNSMedia.com reports.

newsAll.head: Jalon Daniels: Will start in place of injured Mayfield
newsAll.body: Head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that Daniels will step in as the Buccaneers' new starting quarterback while Baker Mayfield is out for a "minimum of three weeks" due to a dislocated right thumb, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Ne
